welcome_text: Browse products and save the ones you like to favorites.
card_catalog_text: Open the Catalog tab to see four products with pictures and prices.
card_favorites_text: Tap the heart next to a product. It will appear in Favorites.
empty_favorites: No favorites yet. Tap a heart in the catalog to add a product.
help_text: Use the tabs at the bottom. A heart adds or removes a favorite. Favorites are cleared after a full app restart.
about_text: A study shop for SRS 4. Flutter, ScreenUtil and Easy Localization. These are demo products; no purchases are made.
